rules.known-places: not applicable: the root holds independently built halves (controller, hub, packages/runtime) that each keep their own .conventions; the rest (docs, e2e, scripts, packaging, openspec) is not unit code, ADR 0070
rules.pr-title-english: prose only: the PR title is checked on GitHub by .github/workflows/pr-title.yml and in Claude Code by .claude/hooks/pr-title-english.py; neither runs on a file in the tree, AGENTS.md
rules.unit-shape: not applicable: the root has no units of its own, ADR 0070
